notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
Hey, finally the pach for rumble is here. 

It includes a New UI, multiple bug fixes, new masks with only 4 characters and more effects to the gameplay.

We want your help to expand rumble into a great game. we'd like to know what peolpe want to see in rumble, any effects, gameplay variations, throwable objects, powerups etc. ANYTHING. let us know and we'll see if it's possible to add it. 

Thanks for your support. 

Enjoy!
